Adaptive API for external integrations. ## 📊 API Overview The Adaptive API enables organizations to build comprehensive reporting and analytics around their security awareness training programs. This RESTful API provides programmatic access to track employee training progress, monitor compliance, and generate insights about your organization's security training effectiveness. ### Purpose & Use Cases This API is designed for: - **Compliance Reporting**: Track training completion rates and identify employees with overdue trainings - **Progress Monitoring**: Get real-time visibility into individual and team training progress - **Data Integration**: Sync training data with your HRIS, BI tools, or custom dashboards - **Automated Workflows**: Build alerts and notifications for training milestones or compliance deadlines ### Technical Design The API follows REST principles with: - Resource-oriented URLs that clearly represent your data - Standard HTTP methods (GET for reading data) - JSON responses for easy parsing and integration - Consistent error handling with detailed error messages - Token-based authentication for secure access ### Available Resources | Resource | Purpose | Common Use Cases | |----------|---------|------------------| | **Users** | Access employee directory data | • Export user lists for reporting
• Track user status changes
• Map users to departments | | **Training** | Monitor training campaigns and progress | • Track campaign completion rates
• Identify at-risk employees
• Generate compliance reports | ## 🚀 Quick Start Guide Get started with the Adaptive API in just 3 steps: ### Step 1: Get Your API Token See [Authentication](#section/Authentication) for more details on how to generate and use API tokens. ### Step 2: Make Your First API Call ```bash curl -X GET https://api.adaptivesecurity.com/v2/users \ -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN" ``` ### Step 3: Handle the Response ```json { "users": [ { "id": "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000", "email": "john.smith@example.com", "first_name": "John", "last_name": "Smith", "status": "ACTIVE" } ], "page_after": "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000" } ``` ## 🔐 Authentication All API endpoints require authentication using an API token: ```http Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN ``` **Token Management:** - Tokens are generated in the Admin portal under **Settings → API** - Tokens have a user-set expiration but can be revoked at any time - Store tokens securely - treat them like passwords ## 🌐 Base URL All API endpoints are relative to: ``` https://api.adaptivesecurity.com ``` ## 🚨 Error Handling All API errors follow a consistent JSON structure: ### Standard Error Response ```json { "error_code": "RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND", "message": "The requested user was not found", "status_code": 404, "request_id": "3e502c09-4fd3-42d3-8b3a-4e2f08de0bbf" } ``` ### Validation Error Response ```json { "error_code": "VALIDATION_ERROR", "message": "Request validation failed", "status_code": 400, "request_id": "1d7c1712-2b8e-43f4-90c6-1185e249bdf0", "details": [ { "field": "page", "message": "Page must be a non-negative integer" } ] } ``` ### Error Code Reference | Code | Status | Description | Action | |------|--------|-------------|--------| | `INVALID_TOKEN` | 401 | Token is invalid or expired | Check token validity | | `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Resource doesn't exist | Verify resource ID | | `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 | Request validation failed | Check field errors | | `INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR` | 500 | Server error | Contact support | ## 📋 Request & Response Headers ### Required Request Headers ```http Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN ``` ### Optional Request Headers ```http Accept: application/json Content-Type: application/json # Required for POST/PUT ``` ### Response Headers ```http X-Request-ID: 6acb3ce1-672a-4a49-8fa1-f1a994eef9fd Content-Type: application/json ``` ## 📄 Pagination List endpoints return paginated results for optimal performance: - **Page cursor**: `page_after` field in the response to get the next page - **Default sorting**: By creation date (newest first) ### Pagination Example ```bash # Get the next page of users curl -X GET "https://api.adaptivesecurity.com/v2/users?page_after=5a6dce1e-8d0f-46b1-b263-50b6adca62da" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN" ``` ### Pagination Response ```json { "users": [...], "page_after": "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000" } ``` ## 🕐 Timestamps All timestamps use ISO 8601 format in UTC: ``` 2024-12-10T15:30:45.402Z ```
